{'text': '莎拉·馬修斯（Sarah Matthews）曾於特朗普首屆任期擔任白宮副新聞秘書，後來成為特朗普的批評者。她周日提出了一個她形容為「可怕」的可能性——斯蒂芬·米勒（Stephen Miller）將取代蘇西·威爾斯（Susie Wiles）出任白宮幕僚長。', 'paragraph_context': 'Sarah Matthews, a Trump White House first-term deputy press secretary-turned-Trump critic, on Sunday raised what she described as the “terrifying” prospect of Stephen Miller replacing Susie Wiles as White House chief of staff.'}

{'text': '「看起來特朗普對現狀感到不滿，無論是新聞頭條還是其政府的施政方向，所以他似乎正在怪罪蘇西·威爾斯，聽起來就是這樣，而且她有點失勢了。他一直在做他最喜歡的事，就是到處打電話，看看如果他想換掉她的話，他拋出的那些人選大家怎麼看。」', 'paragraph_context': '“It seems like Trump is unhappy with the way things are right now and the headlines and the way his administration is going, so he is seeming to blame Susie Wiles, is what it sounds like, and she’s kind of on the outs, and he’s been doing his favorite thing, which is calling around, seeing what people think of different names that he floats if he chooses to replace her.”'}

{'text': '「他公開表示會繼續留用蘇西，但我們知道他正在打這些電話，而斯蒂芬·米勒正是其中一個人選。」馬修斯繼續說道。', 'paragraph_context': '“Publicly, he has said that he’s sticking with Susie, but we know that he’s making these calls. And one of those names is Stephen Miller,” continued Matthews.'}

{'text': '她聲稱，這是一個「可怕的可能性，因為我認為蘇西·威爾斯雖然是這屆政府種種惡行的幫兇，但她並不瘋狂」。', 'paragraph_context': 'It’s a “terrifying prospect because I think that Susie Wiles, while she is complicit in the horrors of this administration, I don’t think she’s crazy,” she claimed.'}

{'text': '「斯蒂芬·米勒是個徹底的瘋子，」她說。她指出，在特朗普因為成為跛腳鴨總統而「陷入螺旋式下滑」之際，讓米勒這樣的人在特朗普任期最後兩年入主白宮，將會是「一件非常可怕的事」。', 'paragraph_context': '“Stephen Miller is batshit crazy,” she said, suggesting that the idea of someone like him coming in for the final two years of Trump’s presidency when Trump is “spiraling because he’s a lame duck president” would be “a very scary thing.”'}

{'text': '馬修斯曾在白宮與米勒共事。米勒是特朗普政府強硬反移民議程的設計師之一。馬修斯表示，她與米勒「關係並不太密切」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Matthews, who worked alongside Miller, one of the architects of the Trump administration’s hardline anti-immigration agenda, during her time in the White House, said the pair “weren’t particularly close.”'}
